chunks: And the Day the disbelievers will be brought before the Fire, (it will be asked to them): 'Is this not the truth?' They will say, 'Yes, by our Lord.' It will be said, 'Then taste the punishment for what you used to deny.'
ai.seo_question: What do disbelievers say when asked if the Hellfire is real on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Surah Adh-Dhariyat, this verse highlights the moment of irreversible realization for the disbelievers, who transition from denial to forced acknowledgment upon witnessing the Hellfire. Shia exegetes often emphasize that this 'tasting' of punishment is a direct consequence of their internal rejection of divine truth, marking the end of their opportunity for repentance.
